wallet.comment: 24-word BIP39 seed of the mainnet deploy wallet. CRITICAL: this seed controls ~400 ADA worth of reference-script min-UTXO at deploy time plus ~50 ADA in ceremony fees plus 15 USDCx initial vault seed. Keep this file OUTSIDE git. Add to .gitignore. Prefer hardware-wallet derivation + offline signing for mainnet ceremonies; see `docs/runbooks/v1-mainnet-ceremony.md` §5.

depositToken.comment: Canonical USDCx on Cardano mainnet per whitepaper §1.2. 'policy' is Circle's USDCx minting policy (28 bytes hex). 'name' = hex of "USDCx" = 5553444378. These values MUST match the production USDCx identity; a typo here produces a V1 deployment anchored to the wrong token (unrecoverable without redeploy).

governance.comment: Three founder-connected signers, threshold 3 (3-of-3 unanimity) per whitepaper §5.5. PKHs must match the publicly-disclosed signers on optivaults.app. Post-audit Phase 2 rotation (4-of-5) is executed later via RotateSigners governance TX.

vaultInitialParams.comment: Mainnet launch uses the same params as Preprod — 4.5% perf fee, 60s min_hold, 20/0/80 fee split, 15 ADA seed. These are the validator-enforced hard-cap ceilings (perf 450, hold 21600 = 6h, keeper+gov 3000). Policy changes post-deploy go through governance timelocks.

treasuryInitialParams.comment: Launch defaults per economics.md §4.2. min_audit_reserve=0 at launch (non-binding). Future UpdateParams may raise min_audit_reserve as audit-reserve balance grows — this value is immutable downward.

keeperAuthInitialParams.comment: Mainnet launch: single founder keeper PKH. PermissionlessWithBond mode is deferred until TVL reaches $5-10M (whitepaper §7.2). cooldown_ms = 60s anti-spam; rotation_period_ms = 7 days (inert until multi-keeper Phase 2+); failover_window_ms = 30 min for secondary keepers to step in.

registryInitialParams.comment: Empty whitelists at launch — depositors cannot be routed anywhere. First post-launch governance action: UpdateRegistry adding Liqwid action-validator hashes + Minswap V2 pool script hashes + stable-token identities for DJED/USDM. This is intentional: V1 refuses to ship with pre-populated whitelists that could contain stale addresses from internal-verification-era deployments.

ceremonyOptions.comment: Mainnet uses 120s Blockfrost indexer wait (Preprod 90s) because mainnet indexing occasionally lags during high-load periods. Ref-script min-ADA multiplier 1.10 provides ~10% headroom.
